0xs4n4tg-kinetograph-cli-kinetograph.description: Entry point for making videos and motion graphics with Kinetograph, a video engine with no browser in it. Use first when asked to build, edit, preview or render a video, animation, title card or sound design with Kinetograph, or to run any `kinetograph` command; it says which kinetograph-* skill to load next.

0xs4n4tg-kinetograph-cli-kinetograph-cre.description: Start a new Kinetograph project or add to one. Use when the folder has no Kinetograph project yet, when asked for a new video from scratch, or to install a component, template or taste from the registry with `kinetograph init` and `kinetograph add`.

0xs4n4tg-kinetograph-cli-kinetograph-doc.description: Search the Kinetograph docs at kinetograph.dev and read a page as Markdown. Use when you need a fact about Kinetograph that the other skills do not give: a CLI flag, a guide, a plugin, the compatibility list, terminology or the changelog.

0xs4n4tg-kinetograph-cli-kinetograph-mar.description: Write or change a Kinetograph composition: the Remotion API, native elements (Layer, Rect, Text, Image, Camera, Audio), layout, type, fonts, media, effects, Web Audio sound, timing, plugins, and what the engine draws and does not. Use when writing or editing the TSX, HTML or JSON scene of a video.

0xs4n4tg-kinetograph-cli-kinetograph-mig.description: Move an existing Remotion project onto Kinetograph so it renders without a browser. Use when the user has a Remotion project (remotion or @remotion/* imports, `remotion render` scripts, @remotion/three, @remotion/player) and wants it to run, preview or render with Kinetograph, or asks what in a Remotion project will not work there.

0xs4n4tg-kinetograph-cli-kinetograph-ren.description: Look at, check and export a Kinetograph composition. Use to see frames (`still`, `strip`, `onion`), check a project without pixels (`inspect`, `lint`, `check`, `doctor`, `snapshot`, `audio analyze`), render to MP4, MOV, WebM, GIF or an image sequence, choose codecs, ProRes profiles, alpha and size, or confirm a render came out right.

0xs4n4tg-kinetograph-cli-kinetograph-stu.description: Open Kinetograph Studio, the local editor with a live preview, timeline, props and presets, export and a chat with the coding agent, and work with the person in it. Use when the person wants to preview or tune a video, mark up frames, give you a span of time, answer a brief, storyboard or review panel, or when a message starts with "Markup notes on".

0xs4n4tg-kinetograph-cli-kinetograph-upg.description: Upgrade Kinetograph in a project: the `kinetograph` CLI, its `@kinetographdev/*` packages and plugins together, and the installed agent skills. Use when a command says the CLI or the skills are out of date, when asked to update or bump Kinetograph, or after a version mismatch error.
